fixed: A frame zooming from the crowd into the bubble timed out: the glow of the 893 bubbles was worked out over the whole crowd at close-up size; it is limited to the frame now.
The 893 callout came back in later shots where nothing said it; a callout stands only in the shot whose words say it.
Photo: Mom on the back of the photo was printed mirrored; it reads the right way round now, larger.
Tipping to the view from above squashed the picture flat with bare sky above and below; the camera tilts up and over instead, the view from above coming in from the top.
The dinner table came only on the last word and was gone in under a second; it comes on stories and the line has a short pause after it, so the family is seen telling the story.
The bubble stood empty and cream before the collage; the memory stays in it until the pieces of the collage cover it.
The collage read as a map of coloured boxes; it is the same garden cut into pieces of photos (the sky and tree, the pram on the lawn, a cupcake), taped and stitched.

Diving into the pram, the view from above faded see-through over the baby's own view, a ghost of the face over the sky (Biku: "a weird transition" at 45 to 49 s); the camera dives into the baby's eye and the view from inside the pram opens out of it in a growing circle.
Into the bubble from the crowd was the same kind of see-through fade; it is the lens now, a ringed circle opening out of the bubble.
Close up, all 6,641 people were drawn though a few dozen are in frame and a frame timed out; close up only those in the frame are drawn.

Rebuilt for one continuous camera: the camera flies into your bubble and it opens round you into the garden; back out of the baby's view as the garden closes into the bubble over your head (the baby's own hands and cupcake now in that view); a quick lens on the photo into the album; the dinner table closes into your bubble, which becomes the collage. Moves named close together glide instead of cutting.
